subject: literacy
concept: Analyzing narrative point of view and its effect on how a story is understood
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student rewrites a short scene from a different point of view and discusses what changes
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a narrative excerpt to its correct point of view (first person, third limited, third omniscient)
exercise.abstract: Student explains how a text's chosen point of view shapes what the reader knows and how they interpret events

misconception_flags: identifies the point of view correctly but cannot explain its effect on the reader's understanding

interest_binding: passage content generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
